ModMetaData.name: LTS Ammunition - Inventory Fallback Patch
ModMetaData.author: Allen / ChatGPT
ModMetaData.description: Independent patch for [LTS] Ammunition - Framework. Allows compatible ammunition in pawn inventory to be used when no worn kit has usable ammo. Empty kits still reload normally, and compatible inventory ammo is transferred into empty/not-full kits before map ammo is searched.
